_comment: The per-rig tables pose.js keeps in code rather than in the rig file.
Kept beside humanoid.rig.json so that file stays a verbatim copy of pipeline output.
depth: pose.js computeDepths(). d = (down|up) + mirror*X + dirDep*P*X, see scr_anim_depth.
frontOfHead: facing left pulls the sword arm in front of the head (pose.js:403-404).
side: which limb a chain belongs to, so a rider can drop the one the horse hides.
body(shirt) head(skin) arm(shirt, skin) leg(pants, pants). The hands are bare skin;
appearance.js boneTint() returned shirt for every /arm/ bone, which was wrong.
The head takes headSkin, NOT skin: spr_bone_hand is pure white so a plain multiply by
the skin colour yields the skin colour, but spr_head_base is already painted in
HEAD_SRC[0] = 251,175,93, so it needs the compensating multiplier look_head_tint()
gives. Sharing one slot renders the hand white on the default skin.
shadow: obj_shadow is a spr_player_shadow instance sitting at the owner's own x/y.
gait: which clip each movement state plays, so no GML names a clip.
anchor: the chains hair/face/sword hang off.
attach: head extras. depth is relative to the anchor chain -- pose.js D.HAIR_FRONT is
-10 and D.FACE is -1. sprite names a field on the look struct, not an asset.

role: which mount.riderDepth offset each chain takes when this rig is riding something. The offsets themselves live on the MOUNT's rig (horse.rig.json `mount`), not here, so the editor can tune them and both the demo and the game pick them up.
